svg.title: HU6 in two liver-fat trials: change in liver fat vs placebo
svg.desc: HU6 in two liver-fat trials: change in liver fat vs placebo. Phase 2a, 80 adults, 61 days: placebo +5.4%, HU6 dose groups -26.8%, -35.6%, -33.0%. M-ACCEL Phase 2, 228 adults with MASH, 26 weeks: placebo -6.7%, HU6 dose groups -29.4%, -31.2%, -27.0%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Relative change in liver fat on MRI. Three HU6 dose groups per trial (doses not shown). Both trials Rivus-funded.
